api.feed: Feed feed(QByteArrayView), Feed contains consumed and optional<QJsonObject>; consumes only through first LF including LF, caller retains/re-feeds suffix; no event queue
api.finish: clean EOF idempotent and sealed; incomplete line invalid even when valid JSON; later nonempty feed logic_error, empty feed harmless
api.failure: syntax/duplicate/Unicode/unsafe-integer invalid_argument; structural/byte length_error; later feed/finish logic_error after either failure
api.scope: structure/parser only, no event schema, identity, generation, source, process or playback-state validation
api.integer_type_separation: For fixed integer member names only numeric values get exact integer-token spelling/range checks. Bool/string/null/container wrong types remain parseable for later exact schema rejection.
api.integer_spelling: JSON integer tokens only, nonnegative safe range through9007199254740991; negative-zero integer token allowed; decimal/exponent/rounded/out-of-range number rejected
api.duplicate_keys: compare decoded QString keys per object, including escaped Unicode/slash/quote/backslash equivalents; case-sensitive, no Unicode normalization
api.unicode: strict UTF8 and valid escaped surrogate pairing in all keys/values, no NUL in keys, valid escaped NUL value allowed
api.structure: depth8(root1), objectmembers32, totalmembers128, arrayelements16, totalvalues256(root/membervalues/arrayelements inclcontainers; keys excluded)

test_groups: partial and multiple lines, exact consumed count throughfirstLF, caller-retained suffix including an oversized suffix, earlier complete event survives later invalid suffix
byte-fragmented multibyte Unicode, clean/repeated EOF, truncated/noLF EOF, CRLF and terminal cleanup behavior
decoded duplicate keys including nested arrays and escaped slash/quote/backslash/Unicode, nonBMP equivalence; repeated keys in separate objects/text and distinct normalization/case accepted
strict rawUTF8 and everystring surrogate escapes, malformed JSON/nonfinite/nonobject/trailing/BOM/control failures; valid pair and escaped NUL value
safe integer boundary/negativezero, decimal/exponent/inexact rounded/overflow token rejection for normal/escaped/nested integer names; later-schema wrongtype separation and finite general float
exact16384frame boundary, unterminated/oversized body, key64UTF16 boundary including nonBMP, encodedkey and numbertoken work bounds
independent depth, perobjectmember, totalmember, arrayelement and totalvalue caps
